prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical 3-by-3 editorial photo collage of a stylish young woman posing on a windy, overcast beach, with a moody fashion-shoot atmosphere and consistent outfit across all panels.

Canvas: Tall vertical collage, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 9 equal photo panels arranged in 3 columns and 3 rows. Use thin clean white gutters between panels, no outer text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

Subject details: The same young woman appears in every panel, with long messy dark brown windblown hair, soft glam makeup, glossy lips, defined eyes, gold hoop earrings, layered delicate necklaces, and a confident sultry expression. Outfit: light blue fitted ribbed cropped tank top with thin straps, oversized brown zip hoodie worn off the shoulders, dark loose low-rise cargo jeans, white sneakers, and a small brown shoulder bag with strap visible in several shots.

Setting: Empty gray-brown sandy shoreline at dusk or on a cloudy day, ocean waves on the right side in many panels, wet sand, scattered driftwood and beach debris, low horizon, distant seawall or industrial tower, muted blue-gray sky. Strong coastal wind should visibly move her hair and clothing.

Layout and exact panel count: Include exactly 9 distinct photos:
1. Top-left: high-angle full-body view, woman looking left, one hand raised to shield her eyes, hoodie slipping off shoulders.
2. Top-center: high-angle medium-full shot, leaning forward toward the camera with pursed lips, shoulders bare under the hoodie.
3. Top-right: side/back three-quarter portrait, looking over her shoulder toward camera, ocean behind her.
4. Middle-left: low crouching pose, one hand near her cheek, looking upward with surprised or dreamy expression.
5. Middle-center: standing full-body pose facing slightly left, hands near pockets, feet apart, beach stretching behind.
6. Middle-right: close selfie-like portrait crop, one eye winking or half-closed, lips slightly parted, shoulder bag strap visible.
7. Bottom-left: rear full-body walking-away pose, looking back over shoulder, footprints in sand, ocean to the side.
8. Bottom-center: crouched front pose, leaning toward camera, hands down between knees, intense gaze.
9. Bottom-right: medium portrait with both hands behind or in hair, head tilted back, eyes closed or looking upward, windblown dramatic profile.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion photography, wide-angle lens feel, slightly high-angle perspective in several panels, candid social-media editorial look, grainy film texture, muted teal-gray and brown color grading, soft natural overcast light, shallow-to-medium depth of field, realistic anatomy and fabric detail.

Constraints: Keep the same woman, outfit, beach, and weather across all 9 panels. Do not add extra people, text, signs, borders beyond the white collage gutters, or studio lighting. Maintain a moody windswept beach aesthetic with realistic photographic imperfections.
